text:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered Review Update Video
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt's Remastered update revisted by Travis Northup on Xbox Series X & PC, also available on PlayStation 5 & Nintendo Switch.

"The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered’s greatest asset isn’t that it adds anything the original sorely lacked, but rather that it removes some of the biggest roadblocks to fun the 1.0 version was saddled with. Combat is more challenging but also easier to enjoy, movement is quicker and less irritating, and revised skill trees allow for more freedom. Even if it doesn’t manage to fix some of the technical issues (plus I’m sure there are some bugs waiting for me to encounter them that haven’t reared their ugly heads yet), it manages to make this classic RPG more enjoyable in 2026, and that’s worth yet another ride down its well-trodded roads."

Street Fighter - Official 'Love of Street Fighter' Behind the Scenes Clip (2026)
Take a look at the 'Love of Street Fighter' Featurette for Street Fighter, the upcoming action-fighting movie based on the hit video game series distributed by Paramount Pictures. Hear from the cast about their love of Street Fighter being brought to the live-action rendition of Street Fighter, in theaters on October 16.

Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!

Street Fighter stars Noah Centineo, Andrew Koji, Callina Liang, Joe “Roman Reigns” Anoai, David Dastmalchian, Cody Rhodes, Andrew Schulz, Orville Peck, Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson, Jason Momoa, and more. The film is directed by Kitao Sakurai and produced by Mary Parent, Cale Boyter, Jason Momoa, Takayuki Nakayama, and Stefan Makhoul.

Street Fighter is in theaters on October 16.

text:
Nocturne - Official Trailer (2026) Liev Schreiber, Zazie Beetz
Take a look at the Official Trailer for Nocturne, a crime drama mystery thriller distributed by Apple TV. Lines will be crossed for good in Nocturne, which premieres the first two episodes of Season 1 on October 30 exclusively on Apple TV.

The series tells the story of Jonah Lynn, an ex-soldier turned homicide detective who, tired of working the tough streets of Philadelphia, moves to a small town in western Pennsylvania for a quiet life. But as the town and his family come under attack from the diabolically cunning serial killer Jurek Walter, Jonah must protect all that he holds dear. When the desperate search for Jurek’s last missing victim forces Jonah to send his surrogate daughter, FBI Agent Saga Bauer, up against Jurek, how far will Jonah go?

Nocturne stars Liev Schreiber, Zazie Beetz, Stephen Graham, Bill Camp, Rory Culkin, Chrissy Metz, Poorna Jagannathan, and Gary Carr. The series is directed by Tim Van Patten, Allen Coulter, Logan Kibens, Anu Menon, and Joe Chappelle, with Nocturne being written by John Hlavin and Rowan Joffe.

Nocturne is premiering the first two episodes of Season 1 on October 30 exclusively on Apple TV.

text:
8 Years Isn't Enough: Why This Console Generation Needs to Be Longer - Next-Gen Console Watch
Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week Daemon, Ryan, and Max take a look at ex-PlayStation Worldwide Studios boss Shuhei Yoshida's recent comments about this current generation. Yoshida doesn't think gamers are interested in a PlayStation 6 or really any new generation of gaming hardware, and the PS5/Switch 2 generation should go for as long as possible. While our wallets might appreciate, can PlayStation's business model go beyond the usual 5-7 year lifespan of gaming hardware? And what about Microsoft, whose Xbox business has not been performing well in the last two generations? Maybe their mysterious Project Helix could be the thing that gives that brand a much-needed shot in the arm. Plus we have last week's poll results and a new poll for you to vote on at IGN.com, Spotify, and Discord.

text:
Carrie - Exclusive Clip (2026) Summer H. Howell, Samantha Sloyan
Based on Stephen King's iconic debut novel, Carrie is a bold, timely, and surprising reinvention of the classic coming‑of‑age story, adapted as a television series for the first time by visionary showrunner Mike Flanagan. The series follows misfit high‑schooler Carrie White (Summer H. Howell) who has spent her life hidden away inside the walls of her home with her fiercely protective mother, Margaret (Samantha Sloyan). 

After her father’s sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

Told across eight propulsive episodes, the series expands King’s cultural landmark, deepening its characters and tensions while following the small, everyday choices that build toward a single, shattering night in a gripping, deeply human story about kindness versus cruelty—and whether we’re witnessing the making of a hero, a monster, or something far more complicated.

All eight episodes of Carrie will be released on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, exclusively on Prime Video in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide.
